title: NVKE ValidationProfile
description: What the NVKE validation image expects of a management cluster and its tenants. Every field is optional; an unset one keeps the default for deploy/nico.

controller.description: Where the NVKE controller runs. Each field sets the variable in parentheses, and a run that sets that variable to something else fails.

port.description: The controller Service's port, by number or name (NVKE_CONTROLLER_SERVICE_PORT).

healthTimeout.description: How long the health checks wait for the controller, as a Go duration such as 90s (NVKE_CONTROLLER_HEALTH_TIMEOUT). Default 60s.

expectedVersion.description: The controller version the version check expects. NVKE_CONTROLLER_EXPECTED_VERSION overrides it for one run.

auth.description: The identity the suite mints its controller token for. Each field sets the variable in parentheses, and a run that sets that variable to something else fails.

audience.description: The token audience (NKE_E2E_AUDIENCE). Default: read from the controller's auth ConfigMap.

managementCluster.description: The management cluster the controller runs on.

scope.description: How much of the cluster the health checks hold to: cluster, the default, or namespaces, for a management cluster shared with workloads NVKE neither installs nor depends on. Problems outside the namespaces are reported, not failed.

kubernetesVersion.description: The Kubernetes version the cluster was built with. NVKE_MGMT_CLUSTER_KUBERNETES_VERSION overrides it for one run. Unset in both fails the version check.

probe.description: Where the probe pods run and what they run.

namespace.description: The probe pods' namespace. Default: the suite's own.

tenant.description: What every tenant is expected to have. A run names the tenant to check with NVKE_TENANT_CLUSTER.

namespace.description: The tenant namespace the validation ServiceAccount may create in, where the probe pods run. Default nvke-validate.

nodes.description: How many nodes must advertise GPUs. Unset skips the GPU checks.

image.description: The GPU workload's image, which needs sh. Default nvcr.io/nvidia/cuda:12.9.1-base-ubuntu24.04.

namespaces.description: The namespaces that must each run a workload, replacing the default list.

components.description: The optional components the cluster runs: each a name, or a name and the namespace to look in when not its usual one.

approval.description: How cert-manager approves a request: any, the default, where its own approver approves every one, or policy, where approver-policy approves only what a CertificateRequestPolicy allows.

pvcStorageClass.description: The class the PVC check binds from. Default: the cluster's default class.

requiredWorkloads.description: Deployments, StatefulSets or DaemonSets, as namespace/name, that must exist and be fully available.

workloadVersions.description: Workloads, as namespace/name, one of whose containers must run an image tagged with the version. NVKE_MGMT_CLUSTER_WORKLOAD_VERSIONS or NVKE_TENANT_WORKLOAD_VERSIONS replaces the list for one run.

flags.description: Flags every API server must run with, and their values.

etcdEncrypted.description: Every API server must run with an encryption provider config.

reservedMemory.description: The least memory every node must hold back from pods, as a Kubernetes quantity such as 2Gi.

probeImage.description: The probe pods' image, which needs sh, nslookup and curl.

pullSecrets.description: Secrets in the probe namespace the probe pods pull their image with.
